blind.description: A shield-shaped plaque or crest consisting of a chiseled grey stone border and backing, inset with an ornate bronze or gold metallic plate. The front face features an embossed sun with radiating rays above three horizontal bars, enclosed by a rope-like inner rim. The back is textured grey stone. Geometry is solid, clean, and continuous with no floating or fragmented pieces.
blind.from_above: A thin, segmented grey stone bar with a small rounded golden protrusion at the center corresponding to the raised sun emblem.
defects: balances impossibly upright on its pointed bottom tip without a stand, mount, or base
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-fourth to one-third the height of the figure, roughly 1.5 to 1.8 feet tall.

notes: balances on pointed tip when previewed upright on floor, but intended as wall-hung piece
